quests.name: Bounty: Draugr
quests.plugin: Favor Quests Seperated.esp (new quest from Favor Quests Separated; no later plugin edits it)
quests.canDoWhy: A jarl's bounty for the Rift: kill the draugr at a place picked when the quest starts, then collect your pay.
quests.firstStep: Kill the draugr at the place marked on your map in the Rift

takesYou.place: a draugr crypt in the Rift (likely one of: Angarvunde, Geirmund's Hall, Shroud Hearth Barrow)
takesYou.why: kill the draugr

takesYou.place: Mistveil Keep, Riften
takesYou.why: collect the bounty from the jarl or steward

objectives: Kill the draugr at the bounty location
Collect bounty from the steward (or the jarl)

unsure.why: No start is recorded for this bounty. Its people include an innkeeper and a letter, and the original bounties it copies start on their own when you arrive in a hold. So it probably reaches you as a letter or an innkeeper's tip in the Rift. The jarl and steward are where you collect; they aren't shown handing it out.
The target place is picked when the quest starts; the rules for picking it aren't in these files. The draugr crypts listed in the Rift are a guess at the pool, not a confirmed list.

You collect from whoever is jarl or steward of the Rift at the time: probably Laila Law-Giver, or the steward Anuriel. The records place them in Mistveil Keep in Riften. Another quest casts Hemming Black-Briar as a steward, so the steward can change.
The gold is named by the quest's script and not confirmed. The amount isn't in these files.
You can collect from either the steward or the jarl. The records don't show whether you get to choose, or whether the jarl only pays when the steward can't.

takesYou.place: a dragon lair in Falkreath (likely one of: Ancient's Ascent, Bilegulch Ridge Burial Mound, Evergreen Woods Burial Mound)
takesYou.why: kill the dragon

takesYou.place: Hakkvild's High Hall, Falkreath
takesYou.why: collect the bounty from the jarl or steward

objectives: Kill the dragon at the bounty location
Collect bounty from the steward (or the jarl)

unsure.why: No start is recorded for this bounty. Its people include an innkeeper and a letter, and the original bounties it copies start on their own when you arrive in a hold. So it probably reaches you as a letter or an innkeeper's tip in Falkreath. The jarl and steward are where you collect; they aren't shown handing it out.
The target place is picked when the quest starts; the rules for picking it aren't in these files. The dragon lairs listed in Falkreath are a guess at the pool, not a confirmed list.
You collect from whoever is jarl or steward of Falkreath at the time: probably Siddgeir, or the steward Nenya. The records place them in Hakkvild's High Hall in Falkreath. The court can change hands.
The gold is named by the quest's script and not confirmed. The amount isn't in these files.
You can collect from either the steward or the jarl. The records don't show whether you get to choose, or whether the jarl only pays when the steward can't.
